title: Give the tongue a truer master
summary: The tongue is corrected by praise, restraint, and truth. Return the mouth to praise before it carries hurt. The emphasis here is give the tongue a truer master.
takeaway: Return the mouth to praise before it carries hurt.
lifeApplication: Before the next message leaves your mouth, pause with one breath and choose the sentence that can still be honored tonight.

source.shortMeaning: The tongue is corrected by praise, restraint, and truth.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next message or sentence leaves you, ask if it can still be honored tonight.
